api-foundations.copy: Toast API exposes message, description, tone, variant, lifecycle state, optional action, dismiss behavior, and live-region priority while Design System foundations own severity language, elevation, motion, timing, and accessibility. Width is intrinsic, bounded by the host and the shared Toast maximum. There are no narrow/wide variants: concise content yields a compact toast; longer copy or one action grows it within that bound. Density changes control, spacing and type scale, not placement or width mode. Action and dismiss stay beside the message; use a short action label. Longer workflows belong in persistent feedback or Dialog.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Feedback job: status, progress, warning, recovery, or undo.

props.name: state
props.notes: Lifecycle state: default, visible, action, stacked, or exiting.

props.name: density
props.notes: Shared sm/md/lg scale for controls, spacing, icons and typography; not a narrow/wide or desktop/mobile selector.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Optional Material Symbol override; defaults from tone.

props.name: actionLabel
props.notes: One short verb beside the message (for example Deshacer or Reintentar), rendered only with onAction; never a separate footer.

props.name: onDismissChange
props.notes: Called after manual dismiss or duration expiry.

props.name: duration
props.notes: Optional auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds; pauses on hover or focus inside.

props.name: dismissed
props.notes: Controlled hidden state for parent-owned lifecycle.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.notes: Accessible label for the dismiss control.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Called when the toast action is selected.

props.name: onDismiss
props.notes: Called when the toast is dismissed.
